scenes.title: Who is watching when you are alone?
scenes.viewerPurpose: The inner audience can persist without an actual viewer. The book studies several sources of approval.

cues.text: Nobody is watching, yet you still imagine how your smallest choices would look to an audience.

scenes.viewerPurpose: Approval can help while dependence can restrict. Freedom does not require rejecting other people.
